description: On Android, the app's own page may take the screen a shortcut asked for through phone_open_target, set or remove the last-chat shortcut through phone_last_chat, and ask whether the launcher pins shortcuts and pin Inbox or Messenger through phone_can_pin and phone_pin (HAL-19143). A shortcut only opens a screen, and the shell does nothing while the window is on another page. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets none of these.
